Case note: Petition No. 2153/2022
Client: Gayatri Patel (civil engineer, Hubballi)
Opposing party: Aarti Fernandes
Court: Family Court at Hubballi
Filed on: 12 July 2022
Claim amount: INR 23,40,000/-
Issue: divorce by mutual consent. Both spouses have lived apart for a long time.
Advice given: Apply to waive the statutory cooling-off period.
Outcome: The cooling-off period was waived.
Recommended next step: Attend the second motion hearing.
